title: oreobatus trilobus
intro: Oreobatus trilobus, commonly known as Globe Mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the mallow family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, wounds, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Globe Mallow are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the skin, making it an effective remedy for burns, cuts, and other skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Globe Mallow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
